rows.text: Diluted Earnings Per Share (EPS) of $1.86 was lower than the prior year (Q3 2025: $2.21) primarily due to Loss on impairments, Loss from equity method investments, higher Income tax expense and transformation-related costs.
Diluted EPS pre-impairment* of $2.09 was also lower than the prior year (Q3 2025: $2.27).
